historical_claims.anchor: The young woman is Annelies Mellema.
Born Sanikem, Nyai was sold into concubinage by her father while still a young teenager.
Herman Mellema dies in a nearby brothel under suspicious circumstances.
At last, Annelies is taken from Wonokromo.

description: Follows Minke’s education and relationships, examining colonial law, racial hierarchy, modernity, gender, and the unequal power to speak. Covers The family at Wonokromo; Learning to love, and learning what love cannot settle; A death brings the household to court; The end of the first book.
